priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned disposer
findings.body: When callers dispose an attachment while the socket remains alive, the handler stays registered and continues processing messages. Repeated attach/dispose cycles retain handlers and captured state, causing duplicate processing, listener-limit warnings, and unbounded memory growth.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) but the returned disposer at diff line 3 is an empty function; the PR specifically removes the prior socket.off("message", handler) cleanup, so detached consumers remain registered.
